title: Correct final current
description: Essential: The response must state the magnitude of the current as 2 A (or 2.0 A).

title: Applies force formula
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the formula F = BIL for a perpendicular wire.

title: Correct algebraic rearrangement
description: Important: The formula is rearranged to solve for current: I = F / (B L).

title: Includes correct units
description: Optional: The final answer is presented with the correct unit (Amperes, A).

title: Perpendicular condition stated
description: Optional: The solution notes that the formula F=BIL applies because the wire is perpendicular to B.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula (e.g., F = Bqv, or omitting the length L).

title: Calculation or unit error
description: Pitfall: Making an arithmetic mistake in the division or failing to convert units correctly.
